key_insight: A wall-sensor neural estimator can be highly accurate offline yet still destabilize opposition control in closed loop because the controller changes the data distribution the model sees.
engineering_relevance: For drag-reduction systems, deployment must be judged by closed-loop stability and sensor-actuator consistency, not just by offline reconstruction accuracy.
method: Train a recurrent estimator to predict near-wall detection-plane velocity from the two wall-shear-stress components.
Embed the estimator inside opposition control and test whether offline accuracy transfers to live feedback.
Stabilize deployment using spectral consistency in the actuation and retraining on closed-loop data.
evidence_signal: The estimator reaches about 0.99 correlation and near-unity coherence offline, but in closed loop it decorrelates within a few viscous time units as drag reduction collapses.
watch_item: Low-pass filtering and exponential averaging can postpone numerical failure but may accelerate loss of correlation; closed-loop retraining is needed for robust deployment.
paper_title: Offline accuracy is not enough: closed-loop instability and stabilisation of a wall-sensor neural estimator in opposition control
